title: project-swarm 1.43.0: integrate --jobs CLI wiring, output cap for single-request agents + finishReason, lesson import --dry-run (T82, lessons 324–326)
head: swarm-1.43-caps-pr
body:
## What
- `integrate RUN --jobs <id,...>` now accepts named jobs through the CLI, either value form before or after the run id.
- `validate` refuses oversized existing single-request API outputs with `output-cap-exceeded`; a job `outputCapBytes` or config `outputCap` overrides the 61440-byte total and 15360-byte per-file defaults, and shell agents remain exempt.
- API requests record the last provider `finishReason` in job state, including length retries; `inspect` reports it for incomplete jobs.
- `lesson import --dry-run` previews lenient imports and private-row skips without writing; `--verbose` adds per-row verdicts.
- docs/lessons.md gains public entries 199–203 for field lessons 322–326.

- (b) skip the output cap for agent openrouter → killed by tests/field-lessons-batch-aa-core.test.mjs
- (c) apply the output cap to agent codex → killed by tests/field-lessons-batch-aa-core.test.mjs
- (d) stop recording finishReason → killed by tests/field-lessons-batch-aa-core.test.mjs
- (e) dry run writes the store → killed by tests/field-lessons-batch-aa-lessons.test.mjs
